mobile.unencrypted_connection_note: To połączenie nie jest szyfrowane. Każdy w Twojej sieci może pozyskać Twoje dane logowania.
mobile.invalid_domain_message: Enter your Snipe-IT address as a URL, like https://snipeit.example.com.
mobile.cleartext_not_local_message: http:// only works for a server on your local network. Use https://, or your server's private IP address, like http://192.168.1.10.
mobile.camera_permission_denied_detail: Please enable camera access in your device Settings to use the scanner.
mobile.scan_domain_mismatch_message: This QR code belongs to a different Snipe-IT instance than the one you're signed into.
mobile.scan_hint: Point your camera at a barcode, then tap it to scan
mobile.undeployable_checkout_message: Ten środek ma etykietę statusu, która uniemożliwia wydanie i nie może zostać obecnie przypisany.
mobile.optional_default_deployable: Optional — defaults to Ready to Deploy
mobile.checkin_select_record: Select a checkout record to return
mobile.empty_state_message: Could not load data. Check your connection and try again.
mobile.asset_tag_hint: Leave blank if auto-incrementing is enabled in your Snipe-IT settings
mobile.search_no_results: Brak środków pasujących do Twojego wyszukiwania
mobile.search_no_results_message: Try different keywords or clear your search
mobile.token_login_failed_message: Please check your domain and API token
mobile.filter_no_results_message: Żadne środki nie pasują do Twoich aktywnych filtrów. Spróbuj je zmienić lub wyczyścić.
mobile.no_results_message: No items have been added to your inventory.
mobile.oauth_not_supported: This instance may not support OAuth. It may be out of date or the mobile client may not be configured. Contact your administrator or use an API token below.
mobile.connection_error_message: Could not reach your Snipe-IT instance. Check the domain and try again.
mobile.local_network_permission_hint: If you declined local network access, turn it on for this app in Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
mobile.plain_http_hint: If your server uses plain http, type http:// before the address.
mobile.host_not_found_message: No server was found at this address. Check the spelling of the domain.
mobile.certificate_untrusted_message: This device doesn't trust your server's certificate. If your organization uses its own certificate authority, install its CA certificate on this device (search Settings for "CA certificate"), then try again.
mobile.secure_connection_failed_message: A secure connection to your server couldn't be made. Its certificate may have expired or been issued for a different address, or the server may use an outdated version of TLS.
mobile.certificate_trust_hint_ios: If your server uses a certificate from your organization's own certificate authority, install its profile and turn on full trust for it in Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings. Use the hostname the certificate was issued for, not an IP address.
mobile.connection_timeout_message: Your server took too long to respond. Check the address and that the server is running, then try again.
mobile.invalid_response_message: This address answered, but not as a Snipe-IT server. Check that it's your Snipe-IT address and not a sign-in portal or another website.
mobile.server_error_message: Your Snipe-IT server returned an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later, or contact your administrator.
mobile.permission_denied_message: You do not have permission to perform this action.
mobile.permission_denied_action: You do not have access to {{action}}.
mobile.refresh_permissions_error: Could not refresh permissions. Check your connection and try again.
mobile.clear_all_caches_error: Czyszczenie pamięci podręcznej nie powiodło się.
mobile.help_triage_intro: Bug reports and feature requests start as GitHub Discussions. Once a maintainer confirms a bug is reproducible and actionable, it is promoted to an Issue.
mobile.share_error_report_message: Sending this helps us find and fix problems like this one. We remove your instance address and login details first, and you can see exactly what will be sent.
mobile.error_report_sent_message: If you'd like to file a bug report describing how this happened, open a discussion. Your reference is filled in already, so we can find this exact error occurrence.
mobile.error_report_sent_copy_hint: Copies the reference to your clipboard
mobile.error_reporting_always_description: Errors are sent to the developers automatically. We remove your instance address and login details before sending.
mobile.error_reporting_ask_description: You are asked before each error is sent, and can see exactly what it contains first. Crashes that close the app are sent without asking, because the app is no longer running to ask you. Choose Never to stop those too.
mobile.error_reporting_never_description: Nothing is sent, including crashes that close the app.
mobile.help_error_reference_description: Include this reference when you report a problem, so we can find the error report you shared.
mobile.open_link_failed_message: Your device would not open this link. Copy it and paste it into a browser.
